name: Sungrow Power Supply Co., Ltd. (阳光电源股份有限公司)
summary: Sungrow is one of the world's largest manufacturers of solar PV inverters and battery energy storage systems, founded in 1997 by Hefei University of Technology academic Cao Renxian, with additional businesses in wind power converters, EV drive/charging equipment, floating PV, hydrogen electrolyzers, and renewable plant development. Listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext since 2011; a Hong Kong H-share application was re-filed in April 2026 (the first, from October 2025, lapsed) — the A+H structure was pending as of August 2026.
ecosystemRole: Ranked No. 1 in BOTH Wood Mackenzie's Global BESS Integrator Comprehensive Ranking and its Global PV Inverter Manufacturer Comprehensive Ranking (2026 edition, assessing 2025) — the first company to take the integrator top spot from Tesla. Company-reported 2025 shipments: 43 GWh of storage (+53.5%) and 143 GW of inverters. ESS revenue overtook inverters as the largest segment in FY2025 (41.8% of revenue at a 36.5% gross margin). BloombergNEF has named Sungrow the most bankable ESS and PCS brand.

productsAndServices.name: PV inverters (string, central, modular)
productsAndServices.description: Full range from residential (SG-RS) to utility-scale (SG350HX and the '1+X' modular platform). 2025 shipments were 143 GW, down ~2.7% YoY as China's residential market contracted after the '531' policy, while overseas shipments grew ~12%.

productsAndServices.name: Utility-scale BESS — PowerTitan 1.0 / 2.0 / 3.0
productsAndServices.description: Liquid-cooled containerized AC-block systems: PowerTitan 2.0 (5 MWh / 2.5 MW per 20-ft unit) and PowerTitan 3.0 (June 2025) on the first mass-producible 684 Ah cell.
highlights: 7.8 GWh Algihaz Holding order in Saudi Arabia (July 2024 — then the world's largest ESS order; 1,500+ PowerTitan 2.0 units, grid-connected 2025)
7.5 GWh of PowerTitan 3.0 + 2.6 GW of inverters for Masdar's 5.2 GW/19 GWh round-the-clock Abu Dhabi project (May 2026, ~40% of its battery capacity, COD 2027)

productsAndServices.name: C&I and residential storage
productsAndServices.description: PowerStack 255CS/510CS liquid-cooled C&I systems covering 400 V–35 kV applications, plus residential three-phase hybrid inverters with stackable battery modules sold across Europe and Australia.

productsAndServices.name: Storage PCS & grid-forming
productsAndServices.description: In-house storage PCS line, including the fully liquid-cooled silicon-carbide PCS integrated in PowerTitan 3.0; grid-forming capability brought to Europe in January 2026.

productsAndServices.name: Hydrogen, floating PV & wind converters
productsAndServices.description: Subsidiary Sungrow Hydrogen supplies alkaline and PEM electrolyzers and green-hydrogen plant equipment; Sungrow FPV is a leading floating-body/anchoring supplier; the company remains a major Chinese wind power converter vendor. Volume figures not published.
